name: juriscan_version
description: Build and schema versions; no remote update lookup.

name: juriscan_capabilities
description: Actual technical coverage and explicit limitations.

name: juriscan_health
description: Check authorized roots are available without exposing credentials.

name: juriscan_scan
description: Read-only bounded scan of an explicitly allowed root. Request cancellation is supported by MCP.

name: juriscan_project_profile
description: Scan supported files and summarize observed domains. This is not a complete dependency or data-flow inventory.

name: juriscan_scan_status
description: Retrieve a retained completed, partial or cancelled scan status.

name: juriscan_findings
description: Paginated observations; no source excerpts or credential values.

name: juriscan_get_finding
description: Retrieve one evidence-backed observation.

name: juriscan_legal_intake
description: Normalize user facts and surface missing facts; no invented answers.

name: juriscan_applicability
description: Research candidates only. No legal rule is verified or asserted applicable.

name: juriscan_list_jurisdictions
description: Paginated catalog jurisdictions; all legal obligations remain unverified.

name: juriscan_list_rules
description: Paginated active technical detectors. Legal research is in the legal catalog.

name: juriscan_get_rule
description: Technical detector metadata, acceptance tests, source pointers and limitations.

name: juriscan_legal_catalog
description: Filter the research inventory, including missing primary sources. Not a statement of current law.

name: juriscan_industry_taxonomy
description: Available sectors, product archetypes and feature dimensions.

name: juriscan_industry_checklist
description: Compose sector/feature/market research questions. Uncovered combinations remain visible.

name: juriscan_remediation_plan
description: Prioritized tasks, acceptance tests and human approval gates.

name: juriscan_generate_master_prompt
description: Deterministic bounded implementation prompt, without copying source instructions.

name: juriscan_compare
description: Compare static observations within the same project and scan scope.

name: juriscan_verify
description: Re-scan and compare; does not execute project tests or claim legal remediation.

name: juriscan_report
description: Return JSON, Markdown, text or SARIF in the response; never writes a file.

name: juriscan_rulepack_status
description: Offline legal and technical freshness disclosure.

name: juriscan_purge
description: Discard this session’s in-memory scans.

name: juriscan_ip_review
description: Offline copyright/license/asset provenance and selected brand-term review. No ownership or infringement determination.

name: juriscan_ip_web_compare
description: Explicitly authorized public-reference GET and local byte/text comparison. No upload, search engine, crawling, or infringement conclusion. Requires exact approved domains and authorized_network true.
